The key detail is the ordering introduced by `ModelBase`: ordinary methods are installed by `type.__new__()` before fields contribute their generated methods. The failure is confirmed by the class-construction order: `ModelBase` creates the class with user-defined methods first, then `Field.contribute_to_class()` unconditionally overwrites `get_<field>_display`. I’ll make the generated display helper fallback-only by checking whether the model already exposes that method, then inspect the diff.
